list.comment: updated spell upgrades and spell choices to upgrade too as well as wrote 22 tests to ensure everything meshed well.

task.summary: added cast_manabda so abilities will be inherited to users character and then can be used in the game.
Add unlock_abilities, ability_data tiers, getattr routing, and pytest coverage

refactor: split characters.py into wizard_core, wizard_schools, wizard_abilities, combat, wizard
- wizard_core.py: Wizard class, init, stats, leveling, status effects, cast methods - wizard_schools.py: choose_school, unlock_abilities, learn_spell_sort, sort - wizard_abilities.py: all ability methods, elementals promoted to top-level classes - combat.py: simple_combat - wizard.py: assembly point, patches all methods onto Wizard at import - deleted characters.py - updated imports in main.py and test_pythonproject4.py - all 32 tests passing
refactor: location hierarchy, spawn, combat + 96 new tests

"Fix enemy combat damage pipeline and add tactical AI escalation
- Wire enemy attack() return values to player.take_damage() across all humanoid classes (DesperateTraveler, Enforcer, TitheCollector) — resolves endless combat loop - Add tactical HP conditional to all humanoid attack() methods: escalates to finisher move when player HP is at or below 25% - Fix Humanoid base class __init__ to accept mana, max_mana, manabda as parameters instead of hardcoded values - Expand test suite from 139 to 152 tests — all passing"

Expand combat system: status effects, spell mechanics, morality, balance pass
- Added 8 new status effects: Slowed, Disoriented, Stuttered, Shattered, Weakened, Frostbitten, Charging (3-turn special move tracker) - Converted all spell_data from tuples to dicts with effect, effect_chance, cooldown fields - Every school now has mechanical identity — Dim disorients with 3-turn cooldown and no-stack guard, Glaze slows, Rattle weakens, False Step shatters, etc - Scaled all spell damage ~30% across all 9 schools - Added morality system (0-3 neutral, 4-7 shady, 8+ dark) wired to player choices - Maren approach fully rewritten — morality-reactive narration, choice to enter or not, Mira companion tells at threshold - Fixed gold/loot awards in simple_combat (not just grind) - Fixed Caleb escalation gated behind level 2+ check - Added post-combat rewards to simple_combat - Added spell cooldown tick system for player and enemies - Added charge interrupt on 30% HP threshold hit - Added skip_turn handling in combat loop for Slowed/Shattered - TitheCollector immune to Disoriented - Expanded test suite to 174 tests

fix: rename morality to corruption, fix Mira/Maren bugs, polish main.py narrative, bump RavenSwarm gold, add 191 passing tests
- Renamed morality -> corruption across wizard_core.py and main.py with clear scale comments - Fixed Mira appearing as combat option before joining (combat.py prompt now conditional) - Fixed Maren double description on entry (skip_greet param added to shop()) - Fixed sort() to work with class-based locations via getattr() fallback - Fixed Ignite desc hardcoded feathers reference removed - Fixed double gold/drop counting in grind.py (combat.py is single source of truth) - Bumped RavenSwarm gold_reward 5 -> 15 - Rewrote main.py opening through Vardeth for narrative coherence and immersion - Added Ledger voice 'He's here' before wizard arrival - Guaranteed Sort Rune reaches player on all paths - Added mira_sister_known flag and sister lore (prodigy, busted door) - Added 191 passing tests covering corruption, merchant, wizard core, sort, combat, items, inventory, monsters

feat: add 18 new spells across all 9 schools with full combat logic and 253 passing tests
- Added 2 new spells per school (18 total), each teaching a distinct Python concept - Pyromancy: Smelt (try/except), Flashpoint (bool resistance check) - Cryomancy: Glacial Grind (while/break), Nullfrost (None) - Chronomancy: Interval (range()), Recurrence (for loop) - Necromancy: Exhume (list mutation), Erasure (del) - Enhancement: Magnitude (integer operations), Surge Stack (+=) - Illusion: Mirage (variable reassignment), Doppel (is vs ==) - Conjuration: Summon Stack (list.append()), Threshold (len()) - Shadow: Voidcheck (None check), Shred (string slicing) - Transmutation: Recast (type casting), Overwrite (dict.update()) - Wired all 18 spells via _cast_special_spell dispatcher in wizard_core.py - Each spell prints its Python concept as inline comments during combat - Upgrade system tracked per spell (max 2 upgrades each) - last_spell_cast tracking added for Recurrence - Added make_wizard and make_target test helpers - 253 tests passing
-main.py made more revisions to story logic
